comments.author: notAlig
comments.body_html:
Would it be possible for the tag functionality that most containers have to be added to this case?

Reason I’m asking is that I’m using NIghtingale’s Inventory Organizing Features mod, which uses the game’s tag system to do stuff like prevent my cases from being sorted or moved, which keeps my stash neat. Unfortunately, when I right click on the S.H.I.T case, there is no option to tag it, so it ends up moving around whenever I auto-sort my stash.

Ultimately an insignificant, minor issue, but figured I would ask since I had no luck looking into how to enable the tag stuff myself.

comments.author: Ori
comments.body_html: It’s not possible, no. Since “technically” it’s not a container, or a case. It’s a weapon attachment with specific filters for each slot with a model that looks like a modified magazine case. Same as Jehree’s Gilded Key Storage mod.

comments.author: notAlig
comments.body_html:
Ah, gotcha. I hadn’t quite realized that the case itself wasn’t strictly a container, I think I just looked at the category from the inspect box and assumed. I’ll just have to sort it manually then, no big deal.

Thanks for the reply and taking the time to explain.
